english.title: Responsible person for wild / semi-wild equine over 12 months and moved for slaughter fail to attach sticker
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the

(A)_[owner having primary day-to-day responsibility for a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), that was aged 12 months or over and being moved from a designated area to a place for slaughter,]_
(B)_[keeper of a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), that was aged 12 months or over and being moved from a designated area to a place for slaughter and for which the owner did not have primary day-to-day responsibility,]_

failed to ensure that it had (in addition to an ID) a sticker issued by an issuing body attached to it before it left the designated area, and which was marked with a unique identification number and the date on which it was attached to the equine
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(2), 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
responsible person for wild / semi-wild equine
aged 12 months or over AND
moved from designated area to a place for slaughter
failed to ensure that that the equine had a sticker attached to it
before leaving the designated area
that was issued by an issuing body AND
was marked with a unique ID number and the date it was attached to the equine
